    class Connection {

    }

        OPTIONS

        +hasBody() boolean
    }

    class Connection_Base["Connection.Base"] {

        +url() URL
        +method() Method
        +header(name) String
        +headers() Map

        +proxy() Proxy

        +postDataCharset() String
        +auth() RequestAuthenticator
    }

    class Connection_Response["Connection.Response"] {
        <<interface>>
        +statusCode() int
        +statusMessage() String
        +charset() String
        +contentType() String
        +parse() Document
        +readBody() String
        +body() String
        +bodyAsBytes() byte[]
        +readFully() Connection_Response
        +isTruncated() boolean
        +bodyStream() BufferedInputStream
        +streamParser() StreamParser
    }

    class Connection_KeyVal["Connection.KeyVal"] {
        <<interface>>
        +key() String
        +value() String
        +inputStream() InputStream
        +hasInputStream() boolean
        +contentType() String
    }

    class HttpConnection {
        +connect(url) Connection$
        +newRequest() Connection
        +execute() Connection_Response
    }

    class HttpConnection_Base["HttpConnection.Base"] {
        <<abstract>>
    }

    class HttpConnection_Request["HttpConnection.Request"] {
        <<static>>
    }

    class HttpConnection_Response["HttpConnection.Response"] {
        <<static>>
        +readFully() Connection_Response
        +parse() Document
    }

    class HttpConnection_KeyVal["HttpConnection.KeyVal"] {
        <<static>>
        +create(key, value) HttpConnection_KeyVal$
    }

    class Jsoup {
        +connect(url) Connection$
        +newSession() Connection$
    }

    class Document {
        -connection Connection
        +connection() Connection
        +connection(connection) Document
    }

    class FormElement {
        +submit() Connection
        +formData() List
    }

    class CookieUtil {
        <<utility>>
        +applyCookiesToRequest(req, setter)$
        +storeCookies(req, res, url, headers)$
        +parseCookie(value, res)$
    }

    class UrlBuilder {
        +appendKeyVal(kv) void
    }

    class UrlConnectionExecutor {
        +execute() HttpConnection_Response
    }

    class HtmlToPlainText["examples.HtmlToPlainText"] {
        +main(args)$
    }

    class Parser
    class StreamParser {
        +parse(input, baseUri) StreamParser
    }

    class Progress {
        <<interface>>
        +onProgress(processed, total, percent, context)
    }

        <<interface>>
        +authenticate(context) PasswordAuthentication
    }

    %% Nesting inside Connection
    Connection *-- Connection_Method
    Connection *-- Connection_Base
    Connection *-- Connection_Request
    Connection *-- Connection_Response
    Connection *-- Connection_KeyVal

    Connection ..> Connection_Request : request()
    Connection ..> Connection_Response : response()

    Connection ..> Connection_KeyVal : data()

    Connection ..> Parser : parser()

    Connection ..> RequestAuthenticator : auth()

    %% Interface hierarchy
    Connection_Base <|-- Connection_Request
    Connection_Base <|-- Connection_Response

    Connection_Request ..> RequestAuthenticator : auth
    Connection_Response ..> Document : parse()

    %% HttpConnection implementation
    HttpConnection ..|> Connection : implements

    HttpConnection_Response --|> HttpConnection_Base

    HttpConnection_Response --> HttpConnection_Request : req
    HttpConnection_KeyVal ..|> Connection_KeyVal : implements

    %% Classes that create or consume Connection
    Jsoup ..> Connection : returns

    Document --> Connection : connection
